board: XKC-Y25-NPN (DC 5-12 V) non-contact liquid level sensor, Shenzhen XingKeChuang, 4-wire lead on XH2.54 4-pin plug
reason: Modelled as an active-low NPN open-collector digital sensor (black wire open = normally open, LOW when liquid) per the manufacturer's XKC-Y25-NPN manual V1.6. A 10 kOhm load to 3V3 is the pull-up. The check passed on ESP32 and Pico: spec, wiring, design checks, breadboard, simulator test and PCB.
breakoutPinoutSource: XKC-Y25-NPN manual V1.6 'Terminal sequence' (brown VCC, yellow OUT, blue GND, black COM) and https://www.icstation.com/contact-liquid-level-sensor-ip67-waterproof-output-water-level-detector-p-12292.html
